name: Signal room
premise: A live operations console where every claim reads like an observable system state.
structure: Fixed telemetry rail, dense status rows, amber-on-black controls

name: Specimen
premise: A clinical observation bench where projects are cases and methods are protocols.
structure: White lab field, cyan rules, labelled samples and a vertical index

name: The Daily
premise: A broadsheet newspaper that treats technical work as reported fact.
structure: Masthead, black ink, ruled columns and front-page hierarchy

name: Construction notice
premise: A public works board: blunt, temporary-looking and impossible to ignore.
structure: Safety yellow, black slabs, stencil labels and taped boundaries

name: Green screen
premise: A phosphor terminal that strips the site back to commands, records and traces.
structure: CRT scanlines, compact monospace, prompt navigation and zero ornament

name: Field manual
premise: A battered operator handbook designed to be used with cold hands and bad signal.
structure: Olive canvas, orange tabs, binder sections and numbered procedures

name: Acid index
premise: A photocopied culture sheet dragged through fluorescent ink and hard editorial cuts.
structure: Torn blocks, poisonous colour, rotated records and aggressive marginal type

name: Blueprint
premise: A cyanotype drafting sheet where every section is a drawn part and dimensions appear as you read.
structure: Prussian blue ground, white line-work, title block, dimension lines drawn on scroll

name: Halftone press
premise: A misregistered print proof: CMYK plates slip, halftone dots swell, and headlines bleed at the edges.
structure: Halftone dot fields, offset colour plates, registration marks, stamped proof marks

name: Glass cockpit
premise: A head-up display of amber readouts and dark glass planes.
structure: Lightly responsive panes, amber HUD marks, scan line and live pointer readouts

name: Raked sand
premise: A dry garden: raked lines flow around each section like stones, and the page asks for slowness.
structure: Generative raked-line canvas, sumi ink type and unhurried spacing
